purpose: Source registry for annual public-data preparation, CPI target references, market prices, risk-free rates, and manual fallback controls.

defaultRefreshPolicy.annualReferencePackage: Run once at the start of the investment year, then refresh only if the committee requests a new approved package.
defaultRefreshPolicy.dailyHoldings: Import daily actual holdings from the broker or custodian export format.
defaultRefreshPolicy.monthlyRebalanceCheck: Run monthly; do not trigger trade workflow between monthly checks unless the policy is changed by the administrator.

sources.name: EODHD end-of-day adjusted close
usedFor: daily end-of-day price refresh for every EODHD-supported configured ticker
sources.configuredIn: scripts/public_data_engine.mjs and local EODHD_API_TOKEN environment variable
sources.refreshCadence: manual or scheduled end-of-day refresh within the EODHD account quota
sources.manualFallback: Retain the last successful cache when an EODHD-supported ticker fails. Do not silently substitute another provider.
sources.productionNote: The subscribed interface is licensed for personal use. Confirm company use, commercial use, redistribution, and production entitlements directly with EODHD.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance public chart adjusted close (Tokyo-only exception)
usedFor: exact Tokyo-listed security historical prices only
sources.refreshCadence: seven-day incremental cache refresh only for the configured Tokyo-listed exceptions
sources.manualFallback: Retain the last successful cache or upload an administrator-approved Tokyo market-data file.
sources.productionNote: The current paid EODHD account exchange list does not include Tokyo. Yahoo is an unofficial public endpoint and is acceptable for demonstration continuity, but a licensed Japan-market source is recommended before production reliance.

sources.name: Philadelphia Fed Survey of Professional Forecasters CPI
sources.manualFallback: Decision Committee enters the numeric CPI value after reviewing the source.

sources.name: Cleveland Fed Inflation Nowcasting
sources.manualFallback: Decision Committee enters the numeric CPI value after reviewing the source.

sources.name: BLS CPI public API
sources.manualFallback: Decision Committee enters the forward CPI estimate if forward machine-readable data is not available.

sources.name: Administrator-approved manual market data package
sources.configuredIn: application upload forms and system parameter maintenance
sources.refreshCadence: only when public data is unavailable or the administrator approves a policy update
sources.manualFallback: This is the fallback source; every submitted file must keep import hash, user, timestamp, and version.

sources.name: Institution-approved paid market-data vendor
sources.endpoint: to be selected by the institution
sources.refreshCadence: daily for price data and annual for reference package approval
sources.manualFallback: Use the administrator-approved CSV interface until a paid vendor is selected.
sources.productionNote: Pricing, license scope, and redistribution rights must be confirmed directly with the vendor before production use.
